resolution: Weather and soil are state-level from NOAA stations and USDA SSURGO. Yield baselines are that class's own USDA history for that state. Harvest timing uses a 16-day forecast.
class_note: Only classes USDA prints an acreage for. Where USDA withholds the figure because too few operations report it — black, dark red kidney, small red, cranberry — the crop is grown but the market is too thin to quote a yield for. Navy, pink and small white show none grown or no estimate. Lentils are omitted on the same commercial test: 215 mapped acres across four states. Peas and chickpeas are listed at commodity level because USDA's crop map has one class for each.
